gloss: to clench (one's teeth); to make (gears) mesh

definitions.gloss: to bring the upper and lower teeth together; to clench
definitions.explanation: To close the jaw so that the upper and lower teeth meet, either normally or tightly, as when bracing oneself or holding back pain or anger.

definitions.gloss: to make things mesh or fit together (gears, parts)
definitions.explanation: To fit two toothed or notched parts into each other so that they engage, as with gears; figuratively, to make two things such as arguments or plans fit together.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive partner of ⟦{噛|か}み{合|あ}う→噛み合う：10586_kamiau⟧ (to mesh, to engage): ⟦{歯車|はぐるま}→歯車：04306_haguruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{噛|か}み{合|あ}う→噛み合う：10586_kamiau⟧ (the gears mesh) / ⟦{歯車|はぐるま}→歯車：04306_haguruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噛|か}み{合|あ}わせる (to mesh the gears). The noun ⟦{噛|か}み{合|あ}わせ→噛み合わせ：28430_kamiawase⟧ means one's bite (how the teeth meet) or the way parts engage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噛|か}み{合|あ}わせる: to bring one's teeth together; to clench one's teeth
- ⟦{歯車|はぐるま}→歯車：04306_haguruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噛|か}み{合|あ}わせる: to mesh gears
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噛|か}み{合|あ}わせる: to make a debate engage (so both sides address the same point)
